verdict.rationale: The firm offers O-1 extraordinary-ability visas and says it sets a case strategy and flags foreseeable issues at the start, with attorney review before anything is submitted. That is a generic pre-filing case evaluation, not a documented, structured assessment of evidence against USCIS criteria. The entrepreneur blog covers O-1 job-description structuring rather than how qualification is evaluated. Missing for 10: a documented criteria-by-criteria O-1A evaluation methodology, an explicit O-1A (vs O-1B) focus, a description of the assessment deliverable given to the founder, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed

citations.quote: we immediately set a case strategy, identify any issues we foresee
all work is done under the close supervision of an attorney and reviewed by an attorney before being submitted
